title: Source: src/agent_runtime/commands
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/commands

src/agent_runtime/commands/init.py

Python · Tier A

Expose the shared contracts, registry and parser for human application controls. The package separates slash commands from model tools, skills and prompt macros. Consumers register concrete handlers through the control plane and HTTP adapter; importing this module does not dispatch commands, contact Gateways or start model work.

src/agent_runtime/commands/control_plane.py

Python · Tier A

Translate human application controls into validated client actions over injected conversation, task and native stores. CommandControlPlane verifies exact selected ownership/availability under the queue lock and revalidates mutation targets at the native control endpoint. status returns bounded persisted measurements without inference. Restart has its own coordinator so it can begin despite busy work; clients own navigation and normal confirmation dialogs.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
message 175 Resolve one fixed command-control catalog identity. CommandConflict uses these reviewed messages at the public error boundary instead of propagating arbitrary store/provider details.
CommandConflict 179 Only fixed catalog messages may cross the command error boundary.
CommandControlPlane 190 Adapt slash actions to existing conversation/task/native authorities. Resolve the exact selected target under the task queue lock and return typed client actions for normal control endpoints. Navigation and confirmation belong to clients; this adapter performs no model request or transcript append.
CommandControlPlane.register 198 Register restart and shutdown separately so they do not acquire task admission locks, then bind each catalog command to its fixed action and metadata. Capture each loop action in its handler default so later catalog iterations cannot retarget earlier commands.
CommandControlPlane.application_busy 230 Check accepted non-task requests, native activity and running/input-blocked tasks across current RAM repositories or compatibility SQL stores. Return a conservative activity fact without starting work; restart dispatch does not wait on this check.
CommandControlPlane.require_conversation 262 Require a selected conversation that still exists and has not been tombstoned. Return its ID only after both authorities agree; absent or retired selections raise a fixed CommandConflict.
CommandControlPlane.run_target 274 Resolve request, task, native run and conversation identities without adopting another conversation latest run. For current controls reject superseded attempts/continuations; trace can inspect an older owned attempt. Before a native checkpoint exists, require trace plus task/turn/current-run ownership evidence so stop remains available during preflight.
CommandControlPlane.validate_control 327 Revalidate the same request identity and current target at the native mutation endpoint, then enforce action availability. Translate cancel to the slash stop availability rule; callers hold the task queue lock across validation and mutation.
CommandControlPlane.require_available 337 Reject stopping terminal work, repeated/unavailable pause, or resume/compact when the snapshot does not explicitly allow it. This is a state check over an already resolved target; it does not mutate a run or itself establish ownership.
CommandControlPlane.execute 359 Resolve explicit Stop arguments or reject arguments for other commands, then resolve scope and availability under the queue lock, and return a typed client action. Status/help embed bounded projections; an empty clear-queue request returns success without an action. Stale-target exceptions become fixed errors, and application navigation does not inherit irrelevant run IDs.
CommandControlPlane.status 432 Project the selected conversation lane and owned run without inference. If no request is selected, choose that lane current/latest attempt or its saved last request. Return finite numeric context accounting, explicit estimate/source, timing basis, queue count, persisted token rates and Memory diagnostics; omit prompts, output and target configuration, leaving unavailable measurements absent.
finite 530 Accept finite nonnegative built-in integer/float measurements and exclude booleans or other numeric-like objects from public accounting.
timestamp 537 Return an accepted numeric epoch or parse an ISO timestamp, including Z suffixes. Missing/unparseable values become None so status cannot fabricate a start or completion measurement.

src/agent_runtime/commands/models.py

Python · Tier A

Define the human command request/result and discovery contracts. CommandContext constrains untrusted IDs, CommandInvocation carries parsed input, and CommandDefinition declares handler metadata. CommandResult validates typed client actions and separates public response fields from server-only post-response work. Registry and control-plane owners validate names, availability and actual target relationships; schemas and runtime descriptions remain the public compatibility surface.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
CommandContext 63 Validate only bounded conversation/request/run identities and desktop/mobile surface. Frozen, extra-forbidden values remain untrusted until the control plane resolves their relationships against current state; this object carries no prompt or executable command body.
CommandInvocation 77 Carry the parsed lookup name, quoted argument tuple, original input and validated context to one registered handler. Keeping raw text supports handlers without requiring it to enter logs or model history.
CommandResult 89 Represent an application response and optional typed client action. The after_response callback is server-side work owned by the HTTP adapter; payload deliberately omits it. Constructor validation restricts status, presentation, action kinds and the identities required by each action.
CommandResult.__post_init__ 102 Reject unsupported status/presentation/action vocabulary and incomplete run/conversation actions. Validate context IDs through CommandContext and require structured status/help data or a health endpoint plus prior instance identity for restart/shutdown. This checks shape, not current ownership or command availability.
CommandResult.payload 154 Return only the serializable response contract: status, message, details, client action and presentation. Keep the post-response callable private to the server adapter.
CommandDefinition 168 Describe a registered human application command, its handler, aliases and client availability/presentation metadata. The definition is immutable; runtime target validation belongs to the handler/control plane, and metadata alone does not authorize an action.
CommandDefinition.metadata 195 Expose discovery/help fields without serializing the handler. Aliases become a JSON- compatible list; the canonical slash spelling is derived from the registered name.

src/agent_runtime/commands/registry.py

Python · Tier A

Parse and dispatch exact human slash commands without entering model execution. CommandRegistry owns validated canonical names/aliases and ordered discovery metadata, invokes one registered handler and emits bounded diagnostics. Quoted arguments are parsed as text, never executed by a shell. Unknown or malformed commands return explicit errors; handler failures do not expose their exception details or raw inputs through diagnostics.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
is_command 32 Recognize the reserved slash namespace after leading whitespace. A slash elsewhere in ordinary text does not turn that text into an application command.
parse_command 39 Return None for ordinary text; otherwise remove the first slash, parse shell-style quoting and lowercase only the command name. Preserve argument case and raw input. Empty names or malformed quoting raise ValueError; shlex parsing does not execute a shell.
CommandRegistry 51 Own canonical definitions and their alias lookup, discoverable metadata and synchronous handler dispatch. This registry never invokes the model loop. Diagnostics are restricted to fixed identities/outcomes rather than raw input, result messages or handler exceptions.
CommandRegistry.register 60 Validate every canonical name and alias as nonempty lowercase ASCII identifier text, then reject duplicates before mutating either lookup. Store one definition for discovery and map each accepted alias to it.
CommandRegistry.metadata 81 List canonical definitions in name order when either the canonical name or an alias starts with the supplied prefix. Return discovery metadata once per definition, without invoking handlers.
CommandRegistry.execute 92 Parse and resolve an invocation, replace its context with the supplied validated context and call exactly one handler. Unknown names return discovery suggestions; malformed input returns usage metadata; handler failures become fixed public errors. Apply registered presentation and emit bounded timing/action diagnostics without raw arguments or private result text.

src/agent_runtime/commands/restart.py

Python · Tier A

Coordinate backend and enabled-Gateway restart or shutdown for slash and legacy API callers. gateway_target normalizes deduplication identities; restart_gateway/shutdown_gateway report per-target management outcomes. RestartCoordinator coalesces requests of either kind, defers durable Controller shutdown until after acknowledgement and invokes process handoff or exit only after confirmed saving. Failures remain visible for retry without resending accepted remote requests; callbacks support isolated tests and embedded hosts.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
restart_gateway 114 Request one paired Gateway restart over the selected outbound session or management HTTPS client. Normalize expected transport/protocol failures into per-target outcomes and accept only the known acknowledgement statuses/fields. A restarting reply confirms acknowledgement, not completed service recovery.
shutdown_gateway 129 Request one paired Gateway shutdown through the same transports and validation as restart. A stopping reply confirms that owned work drained and exit was scheduled, not that the process has already exited. Gateways without the endpoint report unsupported.
_gateway_lifecycle 144 Send one restart or shutdown management request and normalize its outcome. Expected transport/protocol failures become per-target outcomes; only known acknowledgement statuses and fields are returned.
gateway_target 241 Normalize the restart identity before deduplication: outbound node, or HTTP(S) scheme/host/explicit port/path plus node. Drop query/fragment, normalize host case and IPv6 brackets, and reject missing node/unsupported endpoints. This does not perform pairing verification or contact the target.
RestartCoordinator 266 Share one lifecycle request (restart or shutdown), Gateway outcome set and asynchronous durable-close attempt across slash and legacy API callers. Request serialization prevents duplicate remote effects and keeps restart and shutdown mutually exclusive; progress remains readable while shutdown blocks. Failed saves/handoffs can retry without repeating accepted Gateway requests.
RestartCoordinator.diagnostics 280 Snapshot the current operation, phase, elapsed time and fixed public error under a short lock. Return None before any request, without waiting for service teardown or checkpoint I/O.
RestartCoordinator._after_response 310 Create at most one lifecycle task and shield it from an individual acknowledgement caller cancellation. Duplicate responses await the same durable-close/handoff rather than scheduling another process replacement or exit.
RestartCoordinator._restart 322 Await the shared shutdown owner with restart retention semantics before any callback, process replacement or exit. Failed saving retains RAM for retry; successful close advances to handoff (restart) or a clean exit (shutdown) and supports synchronous or asynchronous injected callbacks. Report fixed public failure text while logging the internal exception.
RestartCoordinator.request_restart 365 Reserve the application maintenance slot before accepting/coalescing restart. This excludes conflicting maintenance operations without taking the task admission lock.
RestartCoordinator.request_shutdown 370 Reserve the application maintenance slot before accepting/coalescing a shutdown of the backend and, optionally, every enabled Gateway. Nothing restarts afterwards.
RestartCoordinator._request_reserved 402 Serialize acceptance and return an existing nonfailed result of either operation, so a restart and a shutdown can never both own the process. On retry reset progress/task state while retaining prior Gateway outcomes of the same operation. Begin shared shutdown, request remotes only on the first accepted result, and leave actual Controller close to the post-response callback.
RestartCoordinator._request_lifecycle 468 @brief Deduplicate enabled targets, retain registry response order and defer the backend restart or shutdown until after the response. Probe each normalized target once with at most eight workers. Keep duplicate registry rows as skipped references and preserve failures beside successful targets. Return the prior instance identity and the client action for the requested operation; acknowledgement does not prove that a Gateway or the Controller has finished restarting or stopping.
RestartCoordinator.definitions 569 Build the always-available, destructive lifecycle commands. Each handler rejects arguments and uses the same maintenance coordinator as the historical restart endpoint.
RestartCoordinator.definition 607 Build the always-available, destructive restart command with restart-recovery presentation. Its handler rejects arguments and uses the same maintenance coordinator as the historical endpoint.

src/agent_runtime/commands/stop.py

Python · Tier A

Resolve explicit Stop targets without mutating runs or consulting UI list order.

Details

Task numbers are conversation-local creation sequences. Bulk Stop captures current run identities; the native control endpoint revalidates each before cancellation.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
task_rows 16 Read uncapped task identities, including preflight but excluding deleted history.
active_contexts 45 Capture native, task-preflight and ordinary request identities across conversations.
resolve_stop 91 Build an explicit, deduplicated action; never retarget stale client responses.
